items.goal: modify `src/cerebellum/dreamer.ts` buildUserPrompt (lines 285-292) to include entry bodies, not just titles, when entry.source === 'reflect'. Reflect entries carry diagnostic depth (e.g. wp_mrs855ke007 analysis) that the current title-only snapshot discards. Full bodies should be injected under a new <reflection> tag so the dreamer can translate diagnoses into concrete backlogItems with file targets. This unblocks the 'self-improvement loop is broken' gap.

add preservation mechanism in `src/cerebellum/orchestrator.ts` for consecutive-text-only responses whose content length exceeds 500 chars — these are likely diagnostic or reflective outputs (like wp_mrs855ke007) that should be exempt from the 3-strike early-stop rollback. Detect by char-counting the assistant turns before the StuckLoopError trigger; if any turn > 500 chars, write it to `.odysseus/memory/dreams.md` with source='reflect' and related=waypointId BEFORE aborting. Sacred-file change — requires manual review.

add inline self-monitor hook in `src/cerebellum/orchestrator.ts` runWaypoint iteration loop that fires every 3 tool calls. The hook appends a brief observation message to the conversation (NOT an abort, just a nudge) asking the agent to notice patterns like 'am I repeating?' or 'did I misread the goal?'. This addresses the 'reflection is triggered, not continuous' gap — currently self-awareness only runs in dream phase, never during wakeful execution. Sacred-file change — requires manual review.

extend the dreamer in `src/cerebellum/dreamer.ts` with a curiosity-mode alongside the current dream mode. Curiosity-mode reads self-model.md aspirations and generates 'explore X' / 'try Y' style backlog items that are NOT fixes to existing problems — they are capability expansions. Add new origin 'curiosity' to BacklogOrigin in `src/orchestrator/events.ts` and route curiosity-seeded items to pending-review like dreams. This closes the 'all goals are borrowed' gap by giving the agent a third goal source beyond user and dream.
